headline: Romania's Construction Production Increases 16.8% Year-on-Year in Q3
summary: Romania's construction volume surged 16.8% in the third quarter of 2026 compared to the same period last year, according to official statistical data.
why: Construction output data reflects capital investment in real estate, civil engineering, and infrastructure projects in Eastern Europe.

impacts.name: Romania
impacts.why: Strong construction growth points to expanding fixed asset infrastructure investment.
